camera_vantage:
WHERE THE TREE IS (best reading of canon; no official map places it exactly):
1) Ch.1 opens with Eren asleep under a lone tree on a grassy hill. Mikasa wakes him, and they walk back with firewood. Anime ep.1 says that 'while returning to the Shiganshina District' they pass soldiers 'guarding the gates', Hannes among them, drinking. So the hill is outside the district's walls. The manga does not name a gate.
2) Ch.73 (verified on the wiki's Mikasa page): as dawn approaches, the Survey Corps comes from Trost, which lies NORTH, inside Wall Maria. In a 'mountaintop forest' just before the town, Mikasa recognises the place as one where she once gathered firewood and hears the river. The Corps then rides in and flies over the inner (north) wall. So the firewood hills and woods lie just north of Shiganshina.
3) Ch.139 (and THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2): 'Outside Shiganshina District, Mikasa sits by the tree that Eren used to sleep under' and visits his makeshift grave there. The vol.34 extra pages (ch.139 pp.54-57) and the anime credits epilogue are drawn from beside that tree, with the town and later the city in the distance.
4) Children could not leave Wall Maria in 845, so the hill must be inside Wall Maria territory.
Conclusion: the hill and tree are NORTH of Shiganshina. They are outside the district's inner (north) wall and gate, inside Wall Maria, on the rising ground and foothills between the town and the forested mountains. Confidence: medium. The direction is well supported; the distance is not stated anywhere. Suggested distance: about 0.8-1.5 km from the inner gate.

RECOMMENDED CAMERA: a static camera on the hill right beside the tree, looking south (SSE) across the whole district.
- Height: raise it about 40-80 m above the hilltop (or make the hill 80-120 m above the town). A ground-level camera cannot see over the 50 m inner wall, and every major event needs a view into the district.
- Headroom: leave plenty of sky. In 854 the skeletal End Titan rises near the north gate, very close to camera, and 'dwarfs even the newly freed' 50 m Wall Titans (ch.123). Hundreds of 50 m Wall Titans also stand up out of the inner wall right in front of the lens.
- Framing: the tree in the left or right foreground at about one third of the frame, kept the same in every era.

What the frame covers, from near to far:
- Middle ground: the open fields and the small cluster of buildings just north of the inner gate ('the town to the north of the inner gate', ch.79 p.14). Events here:
  - 850: the horse position, Zeke's line of titans with the Beast in its centre, the rock barrages, Erwin's charge riding north TOWARD the camera, and Levi's kills along the titan line.
- Then the inner wall and inner gate. Events here:
  - 845: the Armored breaks the gate; refugee boats leave.
  - 850: the Beast collapses and blocks the gate; Reiner hides inside this wall.
  - 854: the Beast perches on the north gate; a downed airship crashes into the gate; Eren's head is shot off near Zeke; the End Titan rises here.
- Then the district interior:
  - 845: the titan rampage and Carla's death.
  - 850: Attack vs Armored; Bertolt's explosion, mushroom cloud and later crater.
  - 854: the HQ/fort fight and the 300-titan scream.
- Background: the semicircular outer wall and outer gate.
  - 845: the Colossal's hand and head over the wall, then the kick.
  - 850: Eren seals the gate.
  - 854: the Cart Titan fires from a section of the wall (which section is not stated).
- Beyond the outer wall: the southern plains, where the Warriors and the titan horde arrive in 845, and where Marley's reserve airships wait in 854.

Lens and light:
- Lens: a moderate field of view, about 35-50 mm full-frame equivalent. This keeps the 50 m walls and the 60 m Colossal (head about 10 m over the far wall) readable. A wider lens or a slow pull-back may be needed for the End Titan.
- 845: afternoon sun in the manga; the anime moves the Colossal's appearance to 'later that evening', with golden light.
- 850: the operation starts at sunrise, with light from the east (left of frame when looking south).
- Final shots: dense forest.

The same frame also covers the whole epilogue: Mikasa's visits, the growing city, the bombing, the ruins and forest, and the boy and dog arriving at the tree. These are the canon 'shots from the tree'.

ALTERNATIVE (not recommended): a high camera outside the outer wall to the south-east, looking north. It sees the 845 arrival, transformation and kick and the 850 sealing best, but it loses the tree, Erwin's charge and the whole epilogue.

Sources: manga ch.1, ch.73, ch.79, ch.118, ch.123, ch.139 pp.43-57 (vol.34); anime ep.1 and THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2 (credits epilogue); attackontitan.fandom.com pages 'Shiganshina District', 'Shiganshina District (Anime)', 'Mikasa Ackerman', 'Battle of Shiganshina District', 'Toward the Tree on That Hill (Chapter)', 'To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1'.
geography:
ISLAND AND WALLS
- Paradis Island is shaped like Madagascar. The wiki notes the world map is the real one mirrored vertically: Marley is Africa and Paradis is Madagascar.
- Three concentric walls (Maria outermost, Rose, Sheena/Sina) were raised c.743 from Colossus-type Wall Titans.
- Each wall is about 50 m high (ch.1 p.17). The hardened titan flesh forms a smooth stone-like surface, with titans as its core (ch.34; ch.37 pp.7-8; ch.100 p.13).
- Anime ep.1 info card: Maria to Rose about 100 km; Rose to Sina about 130 km; radius of Wall Sina about 250 km.
- The wiki's Paradis Island page says the centre of the walled area sits higher than the outer territories (its own statement, no citation).
- Walls carry wall-mounted cannons (ch.4). Each wall has outward-bulging districts that act as titan lures.

SHIGANSHINA DISTRICT
- The town on the south edge of Wall Maria, 'built within an outcrop of Wall Maria' (Shiganshina wiki): a semicircular, 50 m-high walled protrusion bulging south from the main line of Wall Maria.
- The protrusion walls themselves hold 'the hundreds of Titans inside Shiganshina's Wall' (Armin, ch.118). They crumble and release those titans in 854 (ch.122 pp.38-45; ch.123).
- OUTER GATE (the 'front' or 'south' gate) in the southern arc. It is opened for returning Survey Corps expeditions, with bells ringing in the anime (ch.1; ep.1).
- INNER GATE (the 'back' or 'north' gate, the 'gate to Wall Maria') in the main line of Wall Maria, opening north into Wall Maria territory.
- Size: not given in the main manga. Anime proportions suggest a compact town about 1-2 km across. The real-world model is Nördlingen, Germany (wiki trivia).
- Townscape: a dense late-medieval Central European town. Stone and half-timbered houses 2-4 storeys high, red/brown tile roofs, narrow streets, and a main street the Survey Corps parades along. There are wells (Moblit pushes Hange into one, ch.84 pp.22-23).
- River: a river runs through the town. Squad Levi 'make for the river in the city' (ch.79); the three children sit by it in anime ep.1. Mikasa hears the 'river stream' in the hills north of town (ch.73).
- Boats: sailless boats pulled by pulleys and rails link Shiganshina to Trost by river (ch.2 p.28; Paradis Island wiki). These were the 845 evacuation ferries, boarded at the inner gate.

JAEGER HOUSE
- An ordinary townhouse with a basement doctor's office, close enough to the outer gate to be crushed by flying gate debris in 845 (ch.1-2).
- In 850 it was 'untouched by the Colossus Titan's destruction'; its rubble had lain untouched for five years (ch.85).
- Exact position is not mapped.

NORTH OF THE INNER GATE (inside Wall Maria)
- 'The town to the north of the inner gate': a cluster of buildings right outside the gate where the 850 horses were kept. Zeke's rocks reduced it to rubble (ch.75, ch.79-80).
- Then open fields (Zeke's titan line and the Beast in 850), then hills, a 'mountaintop forest' with Mikasa's firewood area, and the river (ch.73).
- The tree hill is in this zone.
- The road and river run north to Trost (Wall Rose).

SOUTH OF THE OUTER GATE (outside the walls)
- Plains and forests: titan territory before 850.
- On the coast: Marley's 'borderline', where Eldians were turned into titans. The Survey Corps reached it and the ocean in 851 by following a crawling titan (ch.90 pp.33-45).
- From 851 Paradis built a PORT on the coast and a railway, inaugurated in Trost (Paradis Island wiki; ch.106). A station in or through Shiganshina is not confirmed.

STATE BY ERA
- Before 845: intact town and gates; Garrison and cannons on the walls.
- 845-850: outer gate kicked in, inner gate smashed by the Armored, town abandoned and overgrown.
- 850: outer gate plugged by Eren's hardened titan body (ch.74). North gate area collapsed and blocked by the Beast's bombardment (ch.74 pp.35-44). Large parts of the town blasted and burned by Bertolt's explosion and thrown burning houses, leaving a crater (ch.78-79; ch.113 p.31).
- 851-854: resettled from spring 851 and rebuilt by the Reeves Company (ch.90 pp.32-33; ch.109).
  - A military HQ/fort with prison cells beneath and a flat roof.
  - The 109th Training Corps camp.
  - The 850 crater is left, ringed by trees (ch.113 p.31).
  - The outer-gate plug is carved into a passage (ch.119 p.1).
  - The inner gate is evidently cleared or rebuilt: an airship crashes 'in Shiganshina District's gate to Wall Maria' in 854 (ch.118 p.25).
- 854: civilians evacuated weeks before Marley's raid. The town is wrecked again. All walls crumble and the Wall Titans walk away, leaving the district 'in shambles' with no walls (ch.124).
- Later: rebuilt and modernised. In the anime it becomes a modern city and then a futuristic metropolis. It is then bombed into ruin and finally overgrown by forest around a giant tree (ch.139 pp.55-57; Special 2).

events.title: Empty land: the future site of Shiganshina
events.what_happens: Before the walls, Paradis is 'Eldia's last remaining undisputed territory' (ch.86 p.19). No canon panel shows the Shiganshina site in this period. A neutral reconstruction: plains and forest to the south; hills, a forested mountain and the river to the north; and the grassy hill where the tree stands. The tree's age is unknown; it is a mature tree by 845.
events.visible_from_camera: Wilderness: grassland, forest, a river valley, the hill (the tree young or already standing). No walls and no town. Day and season cycles.
events.state_after: Untouched land.
events.sources: ch.86 p.19; wiki 'Wall Titan', 'Paradis Island'; no direct depiction

events.title: King Karl Fritz raises the Walls with Colossus Titans
events.what_happens: The 145th king, Karl Fritz, withdraws to Paradis. With the Founding Titan he turns huge numbers of his subjects into Colossus-type Wall Titans. They form three concentric rings and harden into 50 m walls, with the titans as their core. Wall Maria's southern line and the Shiganshina protrusion (also titan-filled) take shape here. He then wipes the people's memories; the official history says humanity was nearly wiped out by titans 107 years before 850.
events.visible_from_camera: Implied, not drawn: rows of skinless, Colossus-like titans up to 50 m tall walk into a line along the future wall route and the semicircular bulge, steaming. They stop shoulder to shoulder, and a pale crystalline hardening spreads over them until a seamless 50 m wall stands. Every stage of this is a reconstruction; no canon panel shows it at Shiganshina.
events.state_after: The 50 m Wall Maria line and the semicircular Shiganshina protrusion stand. No gates or town yet (when the gates were built is unknown).
events.sources: ch.86 pp.41-42; ch.99 pp.36-39; ch.100 p.13 (Willy Tybur); ch.34 and ch.37 pp.7-8 (titans inside the walls); ch.2 pp.1-2; wiki 'Walls', 'Wall Titan', 'Timeline'

events.title: The town is built: a 'century of peace'
events.what_happens: Humans settle inside the protrusion (no canon founding date). The outer and inner gates, the wall cannons and the Garrison appear. A dense medieval town grows up, with the river and its pulley-and-rail boat link to Trost. Marley exiles Eldians to the island as pure titans, and titans gather most at the southern walls. Survey Corps expeditions leave and return through Shiganshina's outer gate.
events.visible_from_camera: The town grows from scattered buildings into a packed walled town with tile roofs. Cannons and soldiers on the walls; boats on the river at the inner gate. Survey Corps columns now and then leave and return through the outer gate. Pure titans now and then wander the plains outside the south wall.
events.state_after: A fully built, prosperous walled town; both gates intact.
events.sources: ch.1-2; ch.2 p.28; ch.4; ch.86-87; wiki 'Shiganshina District', 'Walls', 'Paradis Island', 'Timeline'

events.title: The Yeager family in Shiganshina
events.what_happens:
In order:
1) 832: Keith Shadis finds the amnesiac Grisha outside Shiganshina's walls and brings him into town (ch.71 pp.8-17).
2) 832-834 (before Eren's birth; the wiki window is c.832-837): an epidemic hits the district, Grisha's antibodies save many people, and he marries Carla, a tavern keeper (ch.71 pp.19-22).
3) 30 March 835: Eren is born (ch.19 p.26; ch.89 p.2).
4) Ch.71 also shows Keith passing Carla with the infant Eren in the street.
5) c.837: Grisha finds the Reiss chapel but chooses to stay with his family (ch.120 p.41).
6) 844: Mikasa's parents are murdered at their remote home. Eren rescues her and she joins the Yeager household; this is where the scarf comes from (ch.5-6).
events.visible_from_camera: Nothing at camera scale. Optional: a Survey Corps return through the outer gate bringing in a lone stranger (832). Otherwise these are narration or caption beats over the peaceful town.
events.state_after: Unchanged peaceful town.

events.title: Eren naps under the tree on the hill
events.what_happens: Eren sleeps under the tree, dreams of Mikasa with short hair, and wakes up crying. Mikasa finds him and they walk back toward town with firewood. They meet Hannes and the Garrison drinking on duty (anime: soldiers 'guarding the gates'). Eren scolds them, and Hannes says the walls have not been breached in 100 years.
events.visible_from_camera: Two small children under the foreground tree, then walking downhill toward the inner gate with bundles of firewood. Clear weather; chimney smoke over a peaceful town.
events.state_after: Normal town.
events.sources: ch.1; anime ep.1 'To You, in 2000 Years'

events.title: The Survey Corps returns through the outer gate
events.what_happens: Bells ring (anime) and the outer gate opens. Commander Keith Shadis's expedition returns with fewer than 20 survivors out of more than 100 and rides up the main street past a crowd. Moses Braun's mother receives only her son's severed arm. Keith later hands command to Erwin Smith. The wiki dates the return to 'the morning before the fall'.
events.visible_from_camera: The outer gate opens. A thin column of horses in green Survey Corps cloaks moves north along the main street, with crowds lining the road. The gate closes.
events.state_after: Gate closed; town intact.
events.sources: ch.1 pp.27-34; ch.71 pp.27-28; anime ep.1; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria' (prelude)

events.title: Grisha leaves for the interior
events.what_happens: Grisha shows Eren the basement key, promises to show him the basement when he gets back, and leaves on a house call in the interior. Shortly after leaving he receives a vision of the fall through the Attack Titan and later goes to the Reiss chapel.
events.visible_from_camera: A lone traveller leaving through the inner gate and heading north past the hill. How he travels is not specified.
events.state_after: Unchanged.
events.sources: ch.1 pp.36-39; ch.121 pp.11-12; anime ep.1; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria'

events.title: Annie's scream-run draws a titan horde toward the wall
events.what_happens: After Marcel is eaten, Annie, as the Female Titan, uses her scream to draw large numbers of pure titans after her as she carries Reiner and Bertolt toward Wall Maria. Dina Fritz's titan is among them. Without Marcel to share the carrying she runs out of stamina before reaching the wall.
events.visible_from_camera: Probably off-screen or on the far southern horizon: a 14 m blonde female titan running ahead of a straggling horde. Titans thicken on the plains south of the wall.
events.state_after: Titans gathering south of Wall Maria.
events.sources: ch.96 pp.6-18; wiki 'The Door of Hope (Chapter)', 'Dina Fritz'; anime ep.62

events.title: The Armored Titan carries Bertolt to the outer gate
events.what_happens: Once Wall Maria is in sight, Reiner takes over from Annie and carries Bertolt and Annie the rest of the way as the Armored Titan. He drops Bertolt at the outer gate and moves away to give him room to transform. The wiki says the attack began 'when the Warriors arrived at Wall Maria' on the afternoon the Survey Corps came back.
events.visible_from_camera: Only if the far southern plain is visible past the outer wall: a 15 m pale-plated titan with figures on it approaching the gate, then backing off. From the hill most of this is hidden behind the 50 m wall.
events.state_after: Bertolt at the foot of the outer gate.
events.sources: ch.96 pp.16-19; wiki 'The Door of Hope (Chapter)', 'Fall of Wall Maria' (The fall)

events.title: Lightning: the Colossus Titan appears
events.what_happens: The three children are talking (anime: by the river). The ground shakes and there is a loud boom: Bertolt transforms just outside the outer gate. Both versions show a skinless hand gripping the top of the wall, then a steaming head rising over the 50 m wall to look over the town. The town freezes and stares.
events.visible_from_camera: A flash and lightning bolt beyond the outer wall, then a shockwave and a huge column of steam behind it. A red, skinless hand appears on top of the wall, then a lipless, bare-toothed head with huge eyes rises about 10 m above the parapet, steaming. The rest of the body is hidden behind the wall.
events.state_after: Walls still intact for a few moments.
events.sources: ch.1 pp.47-52; ch.96 pp.19-27; anime ep.1; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria'

events.title: The kick: the outer gate is destroyed
events.what_happens: With a single kick the Colossal breaks the outer gate apart. Masonry and gate fragments are thrown across the town, flattening houses, and debris lands on the Yeager house and traps Carla. Dust and panic follow.
events.visible_from_camera: An explosion of stone at the outer gate. Building-sized debris arcs over the town and smashes rooftops, raising dust columns. A dark gaping hole is left where the gate was.
events.state_after: The outer gate is a large ragged hole; houses near the gate and along the debris paths are crushed.
events.sources: ch.1 pp.52-54; ch.2; ch.96 pp.27-29; anime ep.1

events.title: The Colossal vanishes; titans swarm Reiner; Reiner lifts Bertolt and Annie onto the wall
events.what_happens: Bertolt leaves his steaming titan. Reiner, who watched the kick, is swarmed by titans and fights them off. A stray titan, Dina Fritz's 'Smiling Titan', walks right past the exposed Bertolt and into the town. In ch.139 Eren reveals that he made her ignore Bertolt, which sent her toward Carla. The Armored Titan reaches Bertolt, carries him and Annie to the top of Wall Maria, leaves them there, and heads through the town toward the inner gate.
events.visible_from_camera: The Colossal dissolving into a cloud of steam. A 15 m armoured titan climbing the outer wall with two tiny figures and leaving them on the walltop, then dropping into the district.
events.state_after: Breach open; Bertolt and Annie on top of the wall.
events.sources: ch.96 pp.29-33; ch.139 pp.9-10; wiki 'Dina Fritz', 'The Door of Hope (Chapter)'

events.title: Titans flood in; panic; the Garrison fights
events.what_happens: Pure titans pour through the breach into the streets and eat people. Civilians flee north toward the inner gate while Garrison soldiers set up a hasty defence.
events.visible_from_camera: Many 3-15 m naked, oddly proportioned human-shaped titans walking in through the hole and spreading through the streets. Crowds streaming north. Puffs of manoeuvring-gear gas and tiny flying soldiers. Dust; the anime adds smoke columns.
events.state_after: Southern part of the town overrun.
events.sources: ch.2 pp.6-16; anime ep.1-2; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria'

events.title: Carla is eaten
events.what_happens: Eren and Mikasa find Carla pinned under the rubble of their house. Hannes arrives, faces the Smiling Titan, loses his nerve and runs off with the children. The titan lifts Carla out and eats her as Eren watches.
events.visible_from_camera: Too small to read at a distance: a tall, thin titan with a fixed wide grin bending over a collapsed house, and a soldier carrying two children running north.
events.state_after: Yeager house wrecked; its basement intact.
events.sources: ch.2 pp.13-24; anime ep.1; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria'

events.title: Evacuation by ferry at the inner gate
events.what_happens: The Garrison funnels survivors to the inner gate and loads them onto boats bound for Wall Rose (Trost); Armin and his grandfather are aboard. Cannons under Fugo ('Hugo' in the anime) fire at advancing titans. The soldiers argue over closing the gate, which would stop the titans but strand the civilians still outside it.
events.visible_from_camera: A huge crowd massed at the inner gate. Boats pulling away north along the river. Cannon smoke puffing from the walltop.
events.state_after: Inner gate open; refugees leaving.
events.sources: ch.2 pp.25-28; anime ep.2; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria', 'Fugo'

events.title: The Armored Titan breaks the inner gate: Wall Maria falls
events.what_happens: Reiner's Armored Titan charges up through the town and cannon fire bounces off it. In the manga the gate is starting to close (Fugo's one worry is getting it shut) when the Armored smashes through it; Fugo's fate is 'Unknown'. The anime shows it 'crashing through the inner Wall and killing its defenders'. Wall Maria is breached. Eren, on a boat, vows to wipe out the titans.
events.visible_from_camera: A 15 m pale-plated titan running up the main street toward the camera through flashes of cannon fire, then a massive impact. The inner gate bursts outward in a cloud of stone, leaving a second hole facing the hill.
events.state_after: Both gates breached; Wall Maria lost.
events.sources: ch.2 pp.27-32; ch.96 p.33; anime ep.1 (end) - ep.2; wiki 'Fugo', 'Fall of Wall Maria'

events.title: Shiganshina overrun; titans pour into Wall Maria
events.what_happens: Titans spread through the town and north through the inner gate into Wall Maria. The rest of Wall Maria's people flee to Wall Rose. All three surviving Warriors, Reiner, Bertolt and Annie, slip in among the refugees and wake up in a refugee camp inside Wall Rose. Off-camera, Grisha kills the Reiss family, finds Eren among the refugees, and turns him into a titan, which eats him.
events.visible_from_camera: Titans walking north out of the inner gate past the hill. An empty, silent town; the boats are gone; the smoke dies away. Night falls with titans standing in the streets.
events.state_after: Town abandoned with both gates open.
events.sources: ch.2 pp.33-36; ch.62-63; ch.71; ch.96 pp.33-35; wiki 'Fall of Wall Maria' (Aftermath)

events.title: The dead town (five abandoned years)
events.what_happens: The town stays empty and its rubble lies untouched for five years. Titans wander Wall Maria, and most of the island's titans drift inside. The 846 'reclamation' operation is never shown reaching Shiganshina.
events.visible_from_camera: Seasons in time-lapse: weeds in the streets, sagging roofs, crushed houses, both gate holes, titans now and then drifting through, snow in winter.
events.state_after: Ruined, overgrown town with two breaches.

events.title: Reiner, Bertolt and Ymir rest on the wall
events.what_happens: After escaping the Survey Corps, Reiner, Bertolt and Ymir rest, exhausted, on top of Wall Maria in the ruins of Shiganshina 'later that night'. Ymir agrees to go to Marley with them and reaches toward the moon. Ymir is later handed over to Marley. ANIME ONLY (ep.37): Zeke waits on top of Shiganshina's inner gate, just out of his titan; the manga does not show him here.
events.visible_from_camera: Moonlit night. Three tiny figures lying on the walltop with no fire. Anime version: a fourth figure on top of the inner gate.
events.state_after: Unchanged ruins.
events.sources: ch.50 pp.46-49; anime ep.37 'Scream'; wiki 'Scream (Chapter)', 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

events.year: 850 (between Historia's coronation and the battle; exact date unknown)
events.title: Beast vs Armored in the ruins
events.what_happens: Reiner and Bertolt want to go back inside the walls to rescue Annie. Zeke refuses, they fight titan to titan, and the Beast easily beats the Armored. Ch.70 shows only the end: the Beast standing over Reiner's battered titan while Bertolt watches in horror and pulls Reiner out. Zeke comes out, puts on his glasses, and says they will wait in Shiganshina for Eren to come to them. Pieck and the Cart are not shown in this beat; the Cart is first seen at Shiganshina in ch.74-75.
events.visible_from_camera: A 17 m ape-like titan and the 15 m Armored brawling in the ruined streets (the fight itself is implied), then the Armored down and steaming with the Beast standing over it. Later, a small camp on top of the wall.
events.state_after: The Warriors camp on top of Wall Maria at Shiganshina.
events.sources: ch.70 pp.42-45; wiki 'A Dream I Once Had', 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (Prelude)

events.title: The Corps leaves Trost; Reiner and Bertolt watch the sunset
events.what_happens: Just before sunset the 208 members of the Survey Corps gather on Wall Rose at Trost, are given a cheering send-off, go down by lift and set out for Shiganshina. Atop Wall Maria at Shiganshina, Reiner and Bertolt sit at the small camp they have made and watch the sun go down.
events.visible_from_camera: Sunset. Two small figures and a small camp (a campfire is plausible here) on the walltop. Nothing else moving.
events.state_after: Ruins; the Warriors' camp on the wall.
events.sources: ch.72 pp.34-46; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (Prelude), 'Bertolt Hoover', 'Reiner Braun'

events.year: 850 (the night before the battle, until just before dawn)
events.title: Night march; the Warriors split up
events.what_happens:
1) On a dark night the Survey Corps rides through the forests, lighting the way with glowing crystals from the Reiss cave and slipping past dozing titans.
2) As dawn approaches, in the 'mountaintop forest' north of Shiganshina, Mikasa recognises her old firewood area and hears the river.
3) Before this, Pieck, scouting in the Cart Titan in southern Wall Maria, has spotted the lights and hurried back to warn the others.
4) The Warriors put out the fire and push the camp remains off the walltop; Armin later finds the fire's remains on the wall, and three cups and a cold kettle at the foot of the wall.
5) Before sunrise they split up. Reiner hides in a cavity inside the wall near the inner gate. Zeke, Pieck and Bertolt go north of the wall, with Bertolt hidden in a perforated barrel later seen on the Cart's back.
6) In ch.73 Hange notes there is not a single titan around: no titan line should be visible yet.
events.visible_from_camera: Darkness. A faint line of small glowing crystal lights snaking through the forest and over the hills toward and past the camera. Earlier, a small four-legged titan hurrying back to the town. The fire on the walltop goes out. Small figures moving off the wall, out of sight. Pre-dawn blue light, NO titans in the fields.
events.state_after: Town still a ruin, with no visible titans and the Warriors hidden.
events.sources: ch.72 pp.42-44; ch.73 pp.7-24; ch.74 pp.10-14; ch.75 p.8; ch.77 pp.25-30; ch.82 (Reiner: split up 'before sunrise'); wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District', 'Mikasa Ackerman', 'Armin Arlert', 'Cart Titan'

events.title: Eren seals the outer gate
events.what_happens: By sunrise the Corps reaches Shiganshina. All the soldiers pull their hoods up, switch to manoeuvring gear and climb over the wall. 100 hooded soldiers rush along the walls toward the outer gate so nobody can tell which one is Eren. Eren freezes at the sight of his hometown, then goes to the gate, transforms, plugs the breach with his titan body and hardens it, and is cut out. The Corps then prepares to seal the inner gate.
events.visible_from_camera: Dawn light from the east. Swarms of tiny cloaked soldiers going over the inner wall and running along the walltops. A lightning flash at the far outer gate; a 15 m dark-haired titan pressing itself into the hole; then pale crystalline hardening and a burst of steam.
events.state_after: Outer gate permanently plugged by Eren's hardened titan shell. Inner gate still breached.
events.sources: ch.73 pp.24-45; ch.74 pp.1-6; anime ep.50; wiki 'Shiganshina District'

events.title: The hunt; Reiner springs from inside the wall
events.what_happens: Armin finds the fire's remains and the camp gear, and Erwin puts him in charge of a search. Soldiers search the houses, then the walls themselves. Reiner bursts out of a hidden hollow inside the wall and kills an officer. Levi slashes him and kicks him off the wall, but Reiner survives and transforms inside the district.
events.visible_from_camera: Soldiers clustering along the inner wall, then a lightning flash at the foot of the wall and the Armored Titan rising inside the town.
events.state_after: Armored Titan inside the district.
events.sources: ch.74 pp.10-34; anime ep.50; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (Early conflict)

events.title: The Beast's titan army appears; the north gate collapses
events.what_happens: Immediately afterwards, north of the inner gate, the Beast and the Cart transform together with 'many dozens' of newly transformed titans. The Cart carries packs and barrels. The Beast throws a boulder that collapses the north gate and blocks it, cutting off the soldiers inside from their horses. The Survey Corps faces a war on two fronts.
events.visible_from_camera: Between the camera and the wall: many lightning flashes at once across the fields, then a line of titans with a 17 m ape titan in the centre and a small four-legged titan with packs. A boulder flies and crashes into the inner gate, which collapses in dust.
events.state_after: Inner gate collapsed and blocked. Two-front battle begins.
events.sources: ch.74 pp.35-44; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District', 'Marlowe Freudenberg'; anime ep.50-51

events.title: Armored climbs the wall; small titans rush the horses; Eren becomes bait
events.what_happens: The Armored Titan climbs Wall Maria to get at the horses on the far side. The Beast sends a horde of 2-3 m titans at the buildings north of the gate where the horses wait. Erwin sends Squads Dirk and Marlene to join Squad Klaus at the horses. Levi goes north to defend them, and the recruits under Marlowe move the horses while Levi kills small titans in the little town. Eren transforms in the middle of the district and runs south as bait. Reiner gives up on the horses and drops back down from the wall to chase Eren.
events.visible_from_camera: The Armored scaling the 50 m inner wall, then dropping back inside. Swarms of small titans running at the houses at the foot of the wall, with soldiers fighting there. A lightning flash in the district centre and the Attack Titan running south.
events.state_after: Horses still alive north of the wall.
events.sources: ch.75 pp.4-30; ch.76; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (The Armored Titan), 'Marlowe Freudenberg'

events.title: Attack Titan vs Armored Titan
events.what_happens: In the middle of Shiganshina, Eren's hardened fists crack Reiner's armour. Reiner then hurls Eren into a building and gains the upper hand. They wrestle until Eren opens a gap in an open street.
events.visible_from_camera: Two 15 m titans grappling among the ruins, buildings collapsing, dust and steam.
events.state_after: More of the town flattened.
events.sources: ch.75 pp.36-45; ch.76; anime ep.51

events.title: Thunder Spears blow the Armored Titan's nape open
events.what_happens: Squads Hange and Levi blind the Armored with Thunder Spears, then a volley blows its nape apart and destroys Reiner's brain. He survives by moving his brain functions into his titan. The titan gives a long roar, a signal to the Colossal.
events.visible_from_camera: Sharp explosive flashes and grey smoke puffs on a titan's head and neck. The Armored collapses, then a long roar.
events.state_after: Armored down but alive.

events.title: The barrel throw
events.what_happens: Hearing the roar, Zeke takes the barrel holding Bertolt from the Cart's back and throws it over Wall Maria. The squads inside scatter. Bertolt lands, finds Reiner alive and tells him to lie on his back. Armin tries to negotiate with him; Mikasa strikes and he escapes.
events.visible_from_camera: The ape titan winds up and throws; a barrel arcs high over the inner wall into the district. Tiny figures.
events.state_after: Bertolt inside the district.
events.sources: ch.77 pp.41-45; ch.78 pp.1-28; anime ep.52

events.title: Bertolt's explosive transformation
events.what_happens: Bertolt flies up above the district on manoeuvring gear and transforms with a devastating explosion. It wipes out Hange's squad as they reach the Armored; Moblit pushes Hange into a well. Squad Levi is outside the lethal radius and is left as the last soldiers in the town.
events.visible_from_camera: Lightning, then a blinding fireball and a shockwave rolling across the roofs. A mushroom cloud of dust and debris rises far above the walls, and the 60 m Colossal emerges from it, steaming. Burning wreckage everywhere.
events.state_after: A large blast crater and burned zone in the district. The crater is still there in 854, ringed by trees.

events.title: The Colossal rampages and throws burning houses
events.what_happens: Not knowing where Squad Levi is, the Colossal hurls burning buildings into the air across the district. It then walks toward the north wall to bring its burning debris to bear on the soldiers outside. Squad Levi makes for the river in the city.
events.visible_from_camera: Burning buildings spinning through the air and crashing into streets. The Colossal striding toward the inner wall, toward the camera.
events.state_after: Much of the district on fire.
events.sources: ch.79 pp.1-11; anime ep.52-53

events.title: The Beast's rock barrage north of the wall
events.what_happens: North of the wall, the recruits clear the small titans from the right side of the little town. The Beast then crushes boulders gathered by Pieck and throws them like a pitcher. The barrages tear apart the veteran squads on the front line. Survivors take cover behind the buildings at the foot of the wall, and Erwin comes down from the wall to join them.
events.visible_from_camera: The ape titan pitching; sprays of rock hitting the fields and houses north of the gate; buildings blown apart; dust.
events.state_after: The houses north of the gate are being reduced to rubble.
events.sources: ch.79 pp.14-32; anime ep.53

events.title: The Colossal kicks Eren onto the wall
events.what_happens: Eren roars to draw Bertolt's attention, is ignored, and grabs at the Colossal's legs to stop it. The Colossal kicks him away, and he slams onto the top of Wall Maria, unconscious.
events.visible_from_camera: The 15 m Attack Titan launched through the air and slamming onto the walltop.
events.state_after: Eren unconscious on the wall.

events.title: Steam blast; the Armored gets back up
events.what_happens: Jean, Connie and Sasha act as decoys, shouting insults, while Mikasa fires Thunder Spears at the Colossal's nape from behind. A massive steam blast deflects the spears, tears away her anchors and gives everyone minor burns. Behind them the Armored Titan has recovered and stands up again. Armin notices the steam has shrunk the Colossal's muscles.
events.visible_from_camera: A sudden huge white burst of steam from the Colossal throwing tiny figures back, then the Armored rising again.
events.state_after: Two enemy titans active inside the district.
events.sources: ch.80 pp.2-10; ch.81 pp.37-45; wiki 'The Nameless Soldiers'

events.title: Erwin's charge
events.what_happens: Erwin convinces the doomed recruits and leads a cavalry charge straight at the Beast, firing signal flares all at once to spoil its aim. The first volley hits Erwin in the side; the second leaves three riders; the third stops the charge. Floch alone is left uninjured.
events.visible_from_camera: From the houses at the wall's foot, a line of riders charges north across the fields TOWARD the camera, trailing flare smoke. Rock volleys tear through them and horses and riders fall. Then stillness.
events.state_after: The field strewn with dead soldiers and horses.
events.sources: ch.80 pp.30-45; ch.81 pp.1-14; anime ep.54 'Hero'

events.title: Levi defeats the Beast Titan
events.what_happens: While the charge draws the Beast's fire, Levi cuts through the titan line around the north end of the town, using the titans as anchor points. He ambushes the Beast and cuts Zeke out of its nape. The Cart Titan snatches Zeke and flees toward Wall Maria while Zeke sends the remaining titans at Levi, who kills every one of them.
events.visible_from_camera: Bursts of steam as titans fall one after another along the line; a tiny speck spiralling around the ape titan, which collapses, steaming. A small four-legged titan dashing away toward the wall; the last titans dropping.
events.state_after: The northern titan line is gone.

events.title: Floch finds Erwin
events.what_happens: Floch, the only survivor of the charge, searches the field, finds Erwin still alive, bandages him, and carries him back toward Levi to get the serum.
events.visible_from_camera: A single rider or figure moving through the field of the fallen, then heading back toward the wall and the district.
events.state_after: Erwin being brought into the district.
events.sources: ch.81 p.36; ch.83 pp.35-36; ch.84 p.14; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District'

events.year: 850 (runs in parallel with the next event)
events.title: The Armored Titan falls
events.what_happens: Reiner runs north toward Eren, and Mikasa blows out his knee with a Thunder Spear. Jean's plan follows. Connie's spear blasts one side of the jaw open; Sasha is hurt and misses. Hange arrives and opens the other side, and Mikasa fires a spear into the open mouth, blowing Reiner out of the nape. The soldiers then blind him and cut off his limbs. All of this finishes just before the Colossal is defeated.
events.visible_from_camera: Explosions on the Armored's knee and head; it topples, steaming.
events.state_after: The Armored's husk evaporating; Reiner captured.
events.sources: ch.82 pp.4-10, 18-23, 30-35; wiki 'Hero (Chapter)', 'Battle of Shiganshina District'

events.title: Armin and Eren defeat the Colossal
events.what_happens: Eren's titan wakes and seems to slip off the wall to the ground near the collapsed north gate, but it is a hardened empty shell. Armin anchors into the Colossal's teeth and bones and endures its continuous steam until he is burned unconscious and falls. Meanwhile the Colossal's muscle wastes away toward a skeleton. Eren, in human form, comes from behind and cuts Bertolt out of the nape.
events.visible_from_camera: The Colossal steaming non-stop and visibly thinning to a bony frame, then dissolving into steam.
events.state_after: Colossal husk evaporating. Eren's hardened decoy shell is left near the inner gate (how long it lasted is not stated).
events.sources: ch.82 pp.1-3, 13-17, 24-29, 36-45; anime ep.54; wiki 'Hero (Chapter)'

events.title: Zeke and the Cart rescue Reiner and leave over the wall
events.what_happens: Riding the Cart, Zeke enters the district and meets Eren, who is holding Bertolt. He sees the blood-soaked Levi coming and flees. Meanwhile Hange's group questions the limbless Reiner and gets Ymir's letter to Historia. The Cart then snatches Reiner away from them. The three Warriors stand on top of Wall Maria, then leave the island.
events.visible_from_camera: A small four-legged titan with a rider darting through the ruins, then climbing onto the 50 m wall, a silhouette on the walltop, and gone.
events.state_after: Bertolt still captive; the Warriors gone.
events.sources: ch.83 pp.5-18, 28-33, 45; anime ep.54-55; wiki 'Cart Titan', 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (Aftermath)

events.title: The serum: Armin's titan eats Bertolt; Erwin dies
events.what_happens: On a rooftop Levi prepares to inject the burned Armin. Floch arrives with the dying Erwin, and Eren and Mikasa fight Levi over the single dose. Levi finally chooses Armin. Armin becomes a pure titan, eats the screaming Bertolt, and comes out healed with the Colossus power. Erwin dies.
events.visible_from_camera: A lightning flash on a rooftop; a lanky pure titan briefly appears among the ruins, then dissolves in steam.
events.state_after: Nine Survey Corps survivors.
events.sources: ch.83 pp.35-43; ch.84; anime ep.55 'Midnight Sun'

events.title: Survivors on the wall; the basement; return to Trost
events.what_happens: Erwin's body is covered and laid in an abandoned house. The nine survivors regroup on top of Wall Maria. Eren, Mikasa, Levi and Hange walk through the ruins to the Yeager house, which the Colossal left untouched. They clear five years of rubble, kick in the basement door and find Grisha's three books and a photograph. The survivors ride back to Trost in the afternoon.
events.visible_from_camera: Tiny figures on the walltop; four figures walking through the burnt, smoking town; then a small group of riders leaving north past the hill. The dead are left on the field and in the town.
events.state_after: Ruined, partly burned town. Outer gate sealed, north gate collapsed and blocked, a big crater.
events.sources: ch.85 pp.4-45; ch.89 pp.21-22; anime ep.56; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (The basement)

events.title: Wall Maria cleared of titans
events.what_happens: With Shiganshina's gate sealed, the 'Executioner from Hell' outside Trost keeps killing the titans left in Wall Maria. The land is clear by the first snowfall, and Wall Maria is declared safe after the winter. Zackly says the 199 dead are to be 'honored and buried at a later day'. Recovering the bodies is implied but never shown.
events.visible_from_camera: Empty ruins through autumn into snow. No titans. Optional: a burial detail collecting the dead from the field.
events.state_after: Titan-free, still in ruins.
events.sources: ch.89 pp.21-22; ch.90 pp.32-33; ch.70 pp.10-17; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District' (Paradis Island strengthened)

events.title: Resettlement begins
events.what_happens: Around springtime, residents of Wall Rose set out to resettle Wall Maria, and former residents return to Shiganshina. The anime ('nine months later') shows people paving a new road toward the town before rebuilding starts.
events.visible_from_camera: Carts and wagons arriving along a new road past the hill; people clearing rubble; the first rebuilt roofs.
events.state_after: Town being rebuilt.
events.sources: ch.90 pp.32-33; anime ep.59 'The Other Side of the Wall'; wiki 'Shiganshina District', 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

events.year: 851 (one year after the Battle of Trost)
events.title: Expedition to the sea
events.what_happens: The Survey Corps' first expedition beyond Wall Maria in six years finds almost no titans. It follows a crawling titan to Marley's 'borderline' and the ocean. The anime starts the expedition from Shiganshina and shows only one titan outside the walls.
events.visible_from_camera: A mounted column heading south beyond the outer wall. How it gets past the sealed gate is not shown.
events.state_after: Town being rebuilt.
events.sources: ch.90 pp.33-45; anime ep.59; wiki 'Battle of Shiganshina District', 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

events.title: Reconstruction and modernisation
events.what_happens: The military puts the Reeves Company in charge of rebuilding the district. The town is rebuilt, but Bertolt's 850 crater is left with trees growing around it. Eren's hardened plug in the outer gate is carved into a passage. The inner gate is evidently cleared or rebuilt, since in 854 there is a working 'gate to Wall Maria'. A military HQ/fort with prison cells beneath it and a flat roof stands in the town, and the 109th Training Corps trains there under Keith Shadis. Across the island a railway is built (inaugurated in Trost) and a port goes up on the coast.
events.visible_from_camera: A rebuilt tile-roofed town; a large multi-storey stone HQ; a grassy, tree-ringed crater; a tunnel through the pale hardened plug at the outer gate; a restored inner gate; trainees practising with manoeuvring gear. A railway at Shiganshina is not confirmed.
events.state_after: Rebuilt garrison town of 854.
events.sources: ch.109 p.9; ch.113 p.31; ch.118 p.25; ch.119 p.1; ch.106; wiki 'Shiganshina District', 'Paradis Island'

events.year: 854 (after the Raid on Liberio; weeks before Marley's attack)
events.title: Civilians forcibly evacuated
events.what_happens: After the Raid on Liberio (the chapter also shows Kiyomi congratulating Zackly on the campaign against Marley), reporters press Hange about Eren's imprisonment and about 'residents being told to leave Shiganshina District'. The military forcibly moves every civilian out, and the order causes confusion. No reason is given. The 109th Training Corps keeps training in the empty town. Inference only: Armin's line about awakening 'the hundreds of Titans inside Shiganshina's Wall' (ch.118) suggests the walls were the planned demonstration site for the Rumbling.
events.visible_from_camera: Lines of wagons and people leaving north through the inner gate; then a town empty apart from soldiers and trainees.
events.state_after: Town empty of civilians.
events.sources: ch.109 pp.9-10; ch.113 p.31; ch.117 ('less than a month'); ch.118; anime ep.70; wiki 'Guides (Chapter)', 'Shiganshina District'

events.title: The Yeagerists arrive with Eren and their captives
events.what_happens: After the restaurant confrontation, the Yeagerists and Eren leave for Shiganshina with their captives: Survey Corps officers including Mikasa and Armin, the Blouse family, Niccolo, Gabi and Falco, and the military leaders who drank the wine. The captives are locked in cells beneath the district's military HQ, which becomes the Yeagerist headquarters and prison.
events.visible_from_camera: Columns of riders and wagons arriving through the inner gate and converging on the HQ.
events.state_after: Yeagerist base and prison.
events.sources: ch.112 pp.9-32; ch.113 p.40; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio' (Rise of the Yeagerists)

events.title: The 109th Training Corps is seized; Floch's party leaves to fetch Zeke
events.what_happens: Keith runs the 109th through a practice defence near the tree-ringed crater. Floch's Yeagerists, with a captive Hange, interrupt it and win the trainees over, and the trainees beat Keith as their initiation. Meanwhile Eren is already in a building in town. Floch's party then rides out with Hange to find Zeke. They find him coming out of a titan carcass while Hange escapes into a river with Levi, and the party heads back toward Shiganshina.
events.visible_from_camera: A crowd of trainees near the crater; a small fight; a group of riders leaving north past the hill.
events.state_after: The Training Corps under Yeagerist control.
events.sources: ch.113 pp.31-40; ch.115 pp.30-41; wiki 'Savagery (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio'

events.title: Armbands, Yelena's revelation, Pieck's approach (interior)
events.what_happens: Yelena sorts everyone in town by armband: white for Yeagerists, red for prisoners who did not drink the wine, black for those who did (ch.115 pp.24-27). In the cells she shoots Griez for insulting Sasha (ch.116 p.12) and tells the Survey Corps prisoners about Zeke's euthanasia plan (ch.116). Pieck, disguised as a Survey Corps soldier, confronts Eren while he questions Gabi and offers to point out the Marleyan infiltrators (ch.115 pp.43-45; ch.116).
events.visible_from_camera: Nothing at camera scale. Use as narration or captions over the occupied town.
events.state_after: About 800 Eldian soldiers in town: about 500 Yeagerists and about 300 who drank the wine.
events.sources: ch.115 pp.24-27, 43-45; ch.116 pp.8-24; ch.117 pp.14-18; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio', 'Griez'

events.title: Marley's revenge: Jaw Titan ambush, airships and paratroopers
events.what_happens:
1) Pieck and Gabi lead Eren onto the HQ roof. Porco's Jaw Titan bursts up through the roof from below, and Eren loses his legs as he transforms.
2) Five Marleyan airships appear over the town; more wait south of Shiganshina for the retreat.
3) Paratroopers with anti-titan rifles drop, along with an anti-titan cannon for the Cart.
4) Porco cuts Pieck free of her chain to Gabi. Pieck throws herself off the roof, transforms and carries Gabi to Magath.
5) Eren jumps off the building into the streets.
6) Reiner parachutes down from an airship and transforms as he descends.
events.visible_from_camera: Lightning bursting out of the HQ roof. The Attack Titan, now with long hair, rises. Five rigid airships overhead and dozens of parachutes. A small four-legged titan leaping from the roof. A lightning flash in mid-air as the Armored comes down.
events.state_after: Battle begins inside the rebuilt town.
events.sources: ch.116 pp.25-45; ch.117 pp.3-12; ch.118 p.7; anime ep.75-76; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio' (First Assault), 'Judgment (Chapter)'

events.title: Attack Titan vs Armored and Jaw; the cannon on the wall
events.what_happens: The Armored and Jaw Titans attack Eren together. He uses War Hammer crystal spikes and impales both. Pieck straps on the anti-titan cannon, and with Magath aboard and the gun crew alongside, the Cart scales Wall Maria. From the walltop Magath shoots Eren's titan through the head. Gunners in the airships and soldiers on the ground keep the Yeagerists' Thunder Spears away. Reiner finally pins Eren, and Eren tears the Armored's jaw off.
events.visible_from_camera: Three titans (15 m, 15 m, 5 m) fighting among the buildings; pale crystal spikes. A small four-legged titan on top of a section of the district wall (which section is not stated), firing a big gun down into the town. Gunfire from the airships.
events.state_after: Heavy damage to the rebuilt town.
events.sources: ch.117 pp.14-45; anime ep.76; wiki 'Judgment (Chapter)', 'Cart Titan'

events.title: Zeke arrives on the north wall and downs the airships
events.what_happens: A boulder smashes into the Armored as it pins Eren: Zeke has arrived as the Beast Titan, perched on the wall at the north gate, coming back with Floch's party. His barrage wrecks all five airships, which start to fall. He keeps the Armored and Jaw at bay and pelts the Cart, which dives off the wall. Floch's Yeagerists split up to flank the Cart.
events.visible_from_camera: The ape titan on top of the inner wall right in front of the camera, throwing. Airships hit, catching fire and sinking. The four-legged titan jumping down off its section of wall.
events.state_after: Five airships going down over the district.
events.sources: ch.117 pp.32-45; ch.118 pp.1-5, 24-26, 38; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio' (The Beast Titan arrives), 'Sneak Attack (Chapter)'

events.title: Prisoners freed; a downed airship crashes into the inner gate
events.what_happens: Onyankopon frees the Survey Corps prisoners. Armin persuades the others, and they free the rest. Pixis sends those without black armbands out in manoeuvring gear and leads those who drank the wine on the ground. Mikasa folds Eren's scarf and leaves it behind; Louise later takes it. As the freed prisoners join the battle, a downed airship crashes into Shiganshina's gate to Wall Maria. Colt, Gabi and Falco head for the north gate where the Beast is perched.
events.visible_from_camera: Fresh waves of manoeuvring-gear soldiers streaming out of the HQ; Thunder Spear explosions. A burning airship crashing into the inner gate right in front of the camera.
events.state_after: Inner gate blocked by airship wreckage.
events.sources: ch.118 pp.8-37; ch.126; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio', 'Airship', 'Sneak Attack (Chapter)'

events.title: Pieck fakes her death; Magath shoots the Beast off the wall
events.what_happens: Pieck comes out of the Cart and lies still to look dead. Marleyan snipers shoot the cheering Yeagerists. The cannon on the Cart's back fires, blowing through the Beast's right shoulder and wounding Zeke in the nape, and the Beast falls off the wall at the north gate.
events.visible_from_camera: A smoking four-legged titan carcass; a cannon flash; the ape titan toppling off the inner wall toward the town side.
events.state_after: Zeke down at the foot of the north wall.
events.sources: ch.118 pp.39-45; ch.119 p.5; wiki 'Sneak Attack (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio'

events.title: Eren cripples the Jaw; Pixis and Nile lead the ground assault
events.what_happens: Reiner recovers. Galliard grabs and bites the Attack Titan's leg as Eren heads for the downed Beast, and Eren beats the Jaw's nape and critically wounds him. Magath shoots Eren again before the Yeagerists strike the Cart from behind. Pixis and Nile lead the ground assault on the Marleyan paratroopers. Armin's group moves to hit the Cart from behind. Reiner touches the Jaw's nape and sees Marcel's memories.
events.visible_from_camera: Titans grappling near the north wall; cannon flashes; small soldiers attacking a four-legged titan; ground troops advancing through the streets.
events.state_after: Fighting concentrated near the north wall.
events.sources: ch.119 pp.2-11; wiki 'Two Brothers (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio'

events.title: Zeke's scream: about 300 soldiers become titans
events.what_happens: Colt brings Falco and begs Zeke not to scream. Zeke screams anyway. Everyone who drank the spiked wine, about 300 people including Falco, Pixis, Nile and Roeg, turns into a pure titan at once. Colt dies holding Falco. The new titans quickly kill the Marleyan soldiers. Zeke sends Falco's titan at Reiner.
events.visible_from_camera: Hundreds of lightning bolts at once across the district, then a crowd of steaming pure titans of mixed sizes among the buildings.
events.state_after: Town overrun by pure titans.
events.sources: ch.119 pp.12-25; anime ep.78; wiki 'Revenge for Liberio'

events.title: The cannon is lost; Falco eats Porco; Eren breaks free
events.what_happens: Pieck and Magath, after killing all of their Yeagerist pursuers except Floch, hit Zeke a second time. Armin and Mikasa then ambush the Cart and knock out the cannon, and Pieck fights on alone. Falco's titan is about to bite into Reiner's nape when the dying Galliard offers himself; Falco eats him and inherits the Jaw. Eren hardens his titan, trapping Reiner's hand in crystal, and runs out toward Zeke in human form.
events.visible_from_camera: A Thunder Spear blast on the Cart; pure titans fighting near the Armored; a white crystal flash.
events.state_after: Eren and Zeke, both in human form, closing on each other near the north wall.
events.sources: ch.119 pp.22-39; wiki 'Two Brothers (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio' (The Summoning of the Titans)

events.title: Gabi's shot
events.what_happens: Gabi picks up Colt's anti-titan rifle and shoots Eren through the neck, taking his head off a few feet from Zeke; the head lands in Zeke's outstretched hand. In the Paths an instant passes: Grisha's memories, then Ymir.
events.visible_from_camera: Small figures near the north wall and a single shot. Nothing large yet.
events.state_after: Eren and Zeke make contact.

events.title: The Rumbling begins: the walls crumble, the End Titan rises
events.what_happens: A spindly, thread-like structure links Eren's head to his body. Wall Maria shatters under and around the fighters, the walls around Shiganshina first and then the whole of Wall Maria. The hardened shells fall away and the hundreds of Wall Titans in Shiganshina's walls stand up. A skeletal titan, Eren's Founding 'End Titan', rises in front of Gabi, where Eren's body lay near the north gate, and dwarfs the freed Wall Titans. All hardening is undone: Reiner's armour comes off as he shields Gabi from falling rubble, and Annie's crystal in Stohess breaks. The outer-gate plug and the 850 decoy shell presumably dissolve too (inference). Eren's voice speaks to every Subject of Ymir.
events.visible_from_camera: The inner wall in front of the camera and the whole semicircular district wall crack and burst. Rows of skinless 50 m titans rise and stand in clouds of steam, the line running to both horizons along Wall Maria. Near the north wall a skeletal colossus with an exposed ribcage and a long spine rises far above them. Earthquake dust; buildings collapse under falling wall rubble.
events.state_after: No walls left: rubble lines and huge standing titans surround the ruined town.
events.sources: ch.122 pp.38-45; ch.123 pp.32-45; ch.124; anime ep.80-81; wiki 'From You, 2,000 Years Ago (Chapter)', 'Island Devils', 'Revenge for Liberio'

events.title: Mopping up Zeke's titans; Yeagerists take over again
events.what_happens:
Zeke's titans keep rampaging.
- Reiner, weakened, collapses; Gabi hides him in an empty building with food and a blanket.
- On a rooftop, Connie escapes with the unconscious Falco to feed him to his mother in Ragako.
- Gabi kills Nile's titan and saves Kaya and the Blouse family.
- Keith saves the trainee Surma from Roeg's titan.
- Jean draws the titans to the fort and wipes them out with massed Thunder Spear volleys from the top floor; Pixis's titan is among the dead.
- Shiganshina is 'in shambles and surrounded by Wall Titans'.
- Floch returns and restrains Yelena and the Volunteers, and the Yeagerists retake the district.
- Off-camera: Marley's reserve airships, waiting south of the district, retreat to warn the mainland; Pieck and Magath watch them go from the wilderness. All five airships over the town were already down.
events.visible_from_camera: Explosions concentrated at the HQ/fort; pure titans falling and steaming; a rider leaving north with a bundle. Standing 50 m Wall Titans all around. Possibly distant airships rising far to the south, though canon shows them from the wilderness, not from the town.
events.state_after: Ruined town under Yeagerist control.
events.sources: ch.124 pp.1-45; ch.125 pp.41-42; ch.118 p.7; wiki 'Thaw (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio' (Aftermath), 'Timeline' (1st Day)

events.year: 854 (starts on battle day; all gone by day 2)
events.title: The Wall Titans march away
events.what_happens: Led by Eren's End Titan, the Wall Titans start walking 'in a line that will take them away from the island' (ch.125) while the soldiers are still busy with Zeke's titans. At the end of the battle Shiganshina is still surrounded by them (ch.124). The last of them leave Paradis during the day-2 Yeagerist rally (ch.126 p.28), and by day 3 the Rumbling is reaching Marley's coast (ch.128-130). Direction: the wiki's 'southward march' is unreferenced, so treat it as 'outward toward the coast and the mainland'.
events.visible_from_camera: Endless lines of 50 m titans standing up and then striding away, ground shaking and dust rising. Steam columns recede toward the horizon. Afterwards, empty rubble lines where the walls stood.
events.state_after: Shiganshina without walls. Rubble or trench lines along the old wall routes (exact look not shown).
events.sources: ch.124 end; ch.125; ch.126 p.28; ch.128-130; wiki 'Rumbling', 'Timeline' (1st/2nd/3rd Day), 'Sunset (Chapter)'

events.title: Floch's terms; Armin rides out; Hange's secret recruitment
events.what_happens: On top of the fort, Floch shoots a Volunteer who refuses to submit and sends the rest to the cells. Keith tells his trainees to go along with the Yeagerists for now. Armin and Gabi ride out after Connie, seen off by the Blouse family. Mikasa finds her scarf gone. That night Hange secretly reaches Jean and Mikasa and recruits them into the new alliance against the Rumbling.
events.visible_from_camera: Small figures on the fort roof; two riders leaving north past the hill; a quiet night in the wrecked town.
events.state_after: Yeagerist-held town; the alliance forming in secret.
events.sources: ch.125; ch.126 (Jean: 'just last night'); ch.127; wiki 'Sunset (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio' (Aftermath), 'Timeline' (1st Day)

events.title: The Yeagerist rally; the Cart's rescue; the wagons leave
events.what_happens:
1) Annie, freed from her crystal in Stohess and helped by Hitch, rides to Shiganshina.
2) Connie, Armin, Gabi and Falco come back from Ragako.
3) Mikasa takes her scarf back from the wounded Louise in the infirmary.
4) Floch proclaims an end to Eldian persecution while Jean appears to side with him. Armin's group finds Annie eating a pie next to them; Hitch finds her farewell note.
5) On the roof of the destroyed HQ, Floch and Jean prepare to execute Yelena and Onyankopon. Jean fires four shots, the signal, and the Cart Titan ploughs through the crowd and swallows Jean, Yelena and Onyankopon.
6) Mikasa, Annie, Armin, Connie, Gabi and Falco drive off in two loaded wagons while Keith watches from an upper window.
7) They stop at Reiner's hiding place in the town, Annie kicks him awake, and he joins them.
events.visible_from_camera: A crowd gathered at the wrecked HQ; a small four-legged titan charging through it; two wagons leaving the ruins; a brief stop inside the town, then they head out.
events.state_after: Shiganshina under Yeagerist control; the alliance gone.
events.sources: ch.125; ch.126 pp.1-45; anime ep.82-83; wiki 'Pride (Chapter)', 'Revenge for Liberio' (Aftermath), 'Timeline' (2nd Day)

events.title: The Yeagerists take the harbour
events.what_happens: The Yeagerists seize the island's harbour, Kiyomi and her engineers before the alliance arrives. Ch.127 has Pieck report it, and the draft cites 'the steam engine' as their transport. Whether the railway runs through Shiganshina is not confirmed.
events.visible_from_camera: Probably nothing. At most, Yeagerist columns leaving the district.
events.state_after: Shiganshina a Yeagerist-held ruin.
events.sources: ch.127 pp.44-48; ch.128; wiki 'Timeline' (3rd Day)

events.year: 854 or later (after the Battle of Heaven and Earth; undated)
events.title: Mikasa buries Eren under the tree
events.what_happens: After Eren's death at Fort Salta, Mikasa decides to bury his head 'in the place where he liked to sleep as a child' and sets off home to Paradis. Neither the journey nor the burial is shown or dated. The next view is the makeshift grave three years later.
events.visible_from_camera: A lone figure at the foreground tree; a small makeshift grave or marker appears at its foot.
events.state_after: Eren's makeshift grave under the tree.
events.sources: ch.139 pp.37-39; THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2; wiki 'Toward the Tree on That Hill (Chapter)', 'Timeline'

events.year: 857 (3 years after the Battle of Heaven and Earth)
events.title: Mikasa at the grave: the scarf
events.what_happens: Paradis is defended by an army formed from the remaining Yeagerists, while the alliance survivors sail toward the island as peace envoys. Outside Shiganshina, Mikasa sits by the tree, tells Eren's grave their friends will arrive soon, and cries. A bird tightens her scarf around her neck and flies off, and she thanks Eren.
events.visible_from_camera: A woman sitting at the foreground tree; a bird flying away; the town in the background (its state in 857 is not clear).
events.state_after: Grave tended.
events.sources: ch.139 pp.43-51; THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2; wiki 'Toward the Tree on That Hill (Chapter)'; the Shiganshina (Anime) gallery labels this '857'

events.title: Mikasa's family visits; Paradis modernises
events.what_happens: 'Years later, Mikasa continues to visit Eren's grave with her new family while civilization on Paradis advances.' The visitors are seen from behind: Mikasa, a man, and a baby or small child. In the anime credits Mikasa ages at the tree, sometimes with an older man. The look of the modernising town is not described in sources found; cars and cranes are a reconstruction.
events.visible_from_camera: A family at the tree, seen from behind. Behind them the town grows and modernises (reconstruction: new buildings, possibly early motor traffic and cranes).
events.state_after: Shiganshina modernising.
events.sources: ch.139 p.54 (vol.34 extra pages); THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2 credits; wiki 'Toward the Tree on That Hill (Chapter)', 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

events.title: Mikasa dies; the city grows
events.what_happens: Mikasa dies of old age and is buried with Eren's scarf (where is not stated). The tree over Eren's grave keeps growing. In the anime, Shiganshina grows in the following centuries from a medieval town into 'a large, bustling modern city, then finally a futuristic metropolis'. The wiki gallery dates these stages 'c.950-1000' and 'c.1000-2000'; those are editors' estimates, not canon.
events.visible_from_camera: An old woman's last visits; the tree getting bigger; the skyline rising behind it (anime: high-rises, then futuristic towers).
events.state_after: Modern city around the old district.
events.sources: ch.139 p.55; THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2 credits; wiki 'Shiganshina District (Anime)', 'Toward the Tree on That Hill (Chapter)'

events.title: War returns: Shiganshina is bombed into ruins
events.what_happens: War finally reaches Paradis, and Shiganshina is destroyed by aerial bombing. The anime shows two stages: first a conflict that leaves the city in ruins, then total destruction by heavy explosions from bombing.
events.visible_from_camera: Aircraft and bombs over the city (exact weapons differ and are unidentified); explosions; the city burning and collapsing. The tree survives.
events.state_after: City flattened.
events.sources: ch.139 p.55; THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2 credits; wiki 'Timeline' (Post Story), 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

events.title: Nature takes the ruins back
events.what_happens: Over many years after the destruction, forest overgrows the ruins of Shiganshina, and the tree over Eren's grave becomes enormous.
events.visible_from_camera: Broken concrete shells covered in vines and trees; a dense forest canopy; a towering tree on the hill.
events.state_after: Forest-covered ruins.
events.sources: ch.139 p.56; THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2

events.title: A boy and his dog find the tree
events.what_happens: A boy and his dog wander through the overgrown ruins of Shiganshina and come upon Eren's tree, now as big as the tree where Ymir Fritz gained her power. Like Ymir's tree, it has a hollow at its base. This is the final image.
events.visible_from_camera: A small boy and a dog walking through the forest toward the gigantic tree in the foreground, with a hollow among its roots.
events.state_after: End.
events.sources: ch.139 p.57 (vol.34); ch.122 (Ymir's tree for comparison); THE FINAL CHAPTERS Special 2 post-credits; wiki 'Timeline' (Post Story)

titan_specs:
HEIGHTS AND SOURCES
- From the Guidebook (vol.6 'answers' guidebook, via the wiki infoboxes): Founding 13 m (p.141), Colossus 60 m (p.143), Armored 15 m (p.144), Cart 4 m and Jaw 5 m (p.146).
- From manga panels: Beast 17 m (ch.35 p.28), Female 14 m (ch.22 p.34), Attack 15 m (ch.8, ch.11, ch.53), Wall Titans up to 50 m (ch.1 p.17; ch.33 p.44).
- War Hammer: about 15 m is a wiki estimate.

COLOSSUS ('Colossal') TITAN (Bertolt; Armin from 850): 60 m.
- Look: skinless red muscle with pale strips of skin and bone, bald head, lipless jaw with bare teeth, deep-set eyes, long arms, constant steam. Tall enough to look over the 50 m walls.
- Steam: it can vent huge blasts of scalding steam. Long venting wastes the muscle down toward a skeleton, while the bones and teeth stay (ch.80-82).
- Transformation energy can be controlled:
  - 845: transforms behind the outer wall with a flash, a boom and steam.
  - 850: transforms in mid-air over the town as a nuclear-style explosion: fireball, shockwave, mushroom cloud, crater (ch.78; ch.113 p.31).
- Strength: one kick breaks the outer gate (845); throws burning houses (850).

ARMORED TITAN (Reiner): 15 m.
- Look: a muscular body covered in pale/ivory hardened plates on the chest, arms, legs and face.
- 845: cannon fire bounces off it.
- 850: climbs walls using hardened fingertips. Thunder Spears blow open its knee, jaw and nape.
- 854: Reiner parachutes from an airship and transforms as he descends. All of its armour falls away when Eren undoes all hardening.

BEAST TITAN (Zeke): 17 m.
- Look: ape-like, covered in light fur, very long arms.
- Throws boulders and crushed-rock 'shotgun' volleys with a baseball pitcher's motion.
  - 850: collapses the north gate and wipes out the cavalry.
  - 854: brings down all five airships from its perch on the north-gate wall.
- Its scream turns people who took its spinal fluid into titans: dozens in 850, about 300 in 854.

CART TITAN (Pieck): 4 m. Four-legged, long-maned, long-enduring; can carry gear and harness-mounted weapons.
- 850: scouts at night, carries barrels (Bertolt's barrel) and crushed boulders, climbs the 50 m wall, rescues Zeke and Reiner.
- 854 at Shiganshina: carries the parachuted anti-titan cannon, fired by Magath and a gun crew, up onto the walltop.
- The armour and helmet ('Panzer Unit' look) are documented at Fort Slava and Liberio, not at 854 Shiganshina. Treat them as unverified for this battle.

JAW TITAN (Marcel, then Ymir, then Porco, then Falco): 5 m. Small and agile, with hardened jaws and claws and armoured face plates.
- 854: Porco's Jaw bursts up through the HQ roof and takes Eren's legs. Falco's pure titan eats Porco and inherits the Jaw the same day.

FEMALE TITAN (Annie): 14 m. Woman-shaped, with blonde hair. 845: seen only on the plains, leading the horde with her scream.

ATTACK TITAN (Eren): 15 m. Lean and sinewy, with dark hair, green eyes, pointed ears and a lipless jaw.
- 850: hardening for the gate plug, hardened fists, and a hardened decoy shell.
- 854: long hair, plus War Hammer abilities (crystal spikes and weapons).

FOUNDING TITAN: 13 m in its normal form.
- Eren's 854 'End Titan' has no official height. It is a gigantic skeleton with an exposed ribcage and a long spine and Eren's titan head. In ch.123 it 'dwarfs even the newly freed' 50 m Wall Titans. Fan estimates of several hundred metres are unofficial.

WALL TITANS (Colossus type): up to 50 m.
- Numbers: Karl Fritz's ultimatum speaks of 'tens of millions' (ch.86 p.42); the wiki says it is unknown whether that is accurate or hyperbole. Rikao Yanagita's analysis estimates about 246,000 in Wall Maria. Shiganshina's own walls hold 'hundreds' (Armin, ch.118), which is the useful figure for the 854 shot.
- Look: like the Colossal: skinless, long arms, varied faces (some with exposed skull and jaw), heavy steam.
- They are not hostile to humans and walk in lines away from the island. They crossed the sea and reached Marley's coast by day 3 (ch.125; ch.130).

PURE TITANS:
- 845: about 3-15 m, naked, sexless, grotesque human shapes with odd proportions. Key one: Dina Fritz's 'Smiling Titan', which is tall and thin with a long neck, a fixed wide grin showing teeth and gums, and neck-length light hair. Its height is not stated. It was drawn to the wall by Annie's scream and eats Carla.
- 850: Zeke's army of dozens, all appearing at once on the battle morning: a horde of 2-3 m titans plus a line of larger titans around the Beast.
- 854: about 300 wine titans of mixed sizes, including Pixis, Nile, Roeg and Falco.
- Armin's pure titan in 850 is large and lanky (height not given).

TRANSFORMATION AND EFFECTS
- Shifting: a lightning bolt from a clear sky (anime: yellow-orange), a blinding flash and a thunderclap, then a burst of hot steam from which the body forms within seconds. Mass scream transformations produce many lightning bolts at once.
- Titans steam while regenerating. Dead titans evaporate, leaving a fading skeleton.
- Hardening: pale, glassy, crystalline (white to blue-white). The 850 gate plug is a hardened titan body wedged into the hole. All hardening on the island is undone at the start of the Rumbling.
- Thunder Spears: explosive bolts fired from tubes on the manoeuvring gear; sharp blasts with grey smoke.
- Marleyan airships (854): rigid airships with gondolas and onboard guns. Five over Shiganshina, all downed; reserve airships wait south of the district.
- Vertical manoeuvring gear: soldiers zipping on cables with puffs of gas. Survey Corps in green 'Wings of Freedom' cloaks; in 850 everyone wears hoods.
open_questions: Exact position and distance of the tree hill. Canon only implies it is north of Shiganshina, outside the inner wall and inside Wall Maria, near the 'mountaintop forest' firewood area within earshot of the river (ch.1, ch.73, ch.139 'outside Shiganshina'). No map shows it.
Shiganshina's real size (diameter of the bulge), wall thickness and gate sizes are not stated in the main manga. Anime proportions or Before the Fall would have to be used.
The river's exact course through the district, and how the 845 boats got through the inner wall (a water gate?). Pulley-and-rail boats to Trost are canon (ch.2 p.28); the layout is not.
Exact position of the Yeager house and of the 851-854 military HQ/fort within the district.

The 845 Warriors' approach: how long Annie's scream-run lasted before arrival, and whether the titan horde could be seen from inside the town before the kick (ch.96 shows only the Warriors' side). Settled: the hand on the wall appears in both versions, and the time of day is manga 'afternoon' vs anime 'later that evening'.
850: when (or whether) Pieck was at Shiganshina between the coronation and the battle. The ch.70 fight shows only Zeke, Reiner and Bertolt. Zeke on the inner gate in ep.37 is anime-only.

850: when and how the collapsed or blocked north gate was cleared and rebuilt before 854 (ch.118 p.25 implies a working 'gate to Wall Maria'), and whether Eren's hardened decoy shell stayed near the north gate until the 854 un-hardening.
850: which way Marlowe's recruits moved the horses (the claim of 'west, away from titans from the east' was not verified), and what happened to the 199 bodies ('to be buried at a later day', ch.89).
851: how the Survey Corps got out through the sealed outer gate for the expedition to the sea (lift over the wall vs. the later carved passage, ch.119 p.1).

Did the railway (built from 851, inaugurated in Trost) run through Shiganshina to the coastal port? The draft says the Yeagerists used 'the steam engine' to reach the harbour (ch.127); the page was not re-checked.
854: time of day and weather of Marley's raid and of the start of the Rumbling (reads as daytime; not verified page by page).

854: which section of the district wall the Cart Titan and its cannon stood on (ch.117 says only 'atop Wall Maria'), and whether the Cart wore armour plates at Shiganshina (documented only for Fort Slava and Liberio).
854: the reason for the forced evacuation of civilians (no reason in ch.109; the Rumbling-demonstration idea is inference from Armin, ch.118).

854: the direction the Wall Titans marched away from Shiganshina (the wiki's 'southward' is unreferenced; Marley lies across the sea from the coast where the port is), and what the old wall routes looked like afterwards (rubble mounds vs bare trenches).

Wiki inconsistency: the Timeline places Floch's day-2 celebration and Armin's meeting with Annie in Trost, but the ch.126 summary and the 'Revenge for Liberio' aftermath put the rally, Annie, Hitch and the HQ-roof execution in Shiganshina. Shiganshina is used here.
Where Hange recruited Jean and Mikasa on the night of day 1 (it seems to be in Shiganshina, but the town is not named).
The End Titan's real height and silhouette (no official figure).
State of Shiganshina in 857 behind Mikasa's grave scene: rebuilt? Any wall remnants?
Where Mikasa is buried and who her family is (deliberately left open). How the modernising town looks in the vol.34 extra pages: cars and cranes were not confirmed by any source found.

The far-future war: the manga shows aerial bombing; the anime shows a conflict and then heavy bombing. The exact weapons and aircraft are not identified. The wiki gallery dates (c.950-1000, c.1000-2000) are editors' estimates.
Whether the boy in the anime post-credits wears a scarf (fan claim; not verified).
Founding date of the town of Shiganshina and of its gates (no canon date; the walls are c.743).
Armin's parents' hot-air balloon attempt (c.844/845): the launch site is not stated, so it is left out of the timeline.
